chapter: Washington, New Orleans and the road
title: The Howard Theater, the Apollo and the theater circuit
summary: In Washington they stayed across from the Howard Theater, met Cab Calloway and Stepin Fetchit, and began playing the theater circuit.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: When we got there, we was a coupla days early so we didn't have no place to stay. So we was lookin' around ever'where. So we found a little hotel 'cross from a theater where they had shows at
every week. Had a circuit, like. You'd play New York. You play Washington, D.C....play Boston. You play Cleveland, and you play Indianapolis.
So we moved to the little hotel right across from the theater. So we met a lot o'...met a bunch of people there...met Cab Calloway... Stepin Fetchit...
The Howard Theater. We met a bunch o' people there we didn't even did not know. So we got in the...gotta idea o' get in the theaters. We didn't have played no theaters before.

So we played up in Washington, D.C. at the nightclub for about three weeks. So, then we decided...we like to play some theaters. Say, "Well, the place to start in playin' the theaters is go to New York. Play at the Apollo Theater first. Then you play the circuit."

So we went to New York an' we played the Apollo Theater. Then we went back to Washington an' played Washington. Then we played all the rest o' the little towns. Then we wind up, after we got through with that, we took off and went down to Louisiana.
